video_title: My FAVE Dolls! Tinyfox Jinku Violet Unboxing (Kikagoods)
evidence: SponsorRadar records KIKAGoods sponsoring Hazel Soda's July 28, 2026 English-language YouTube video 'My FAVE Dolls! Tinyfox Jinku Violet Unboxing (Kikagoods)' and shows repeated KIKAGoods creator spend on the channel. KIKAGoods sells physical collectible toys, blind boxes and figures. Its official Influencer Cooperation page explicitly recruits YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and other creators, while its official business cooperation page publishes marketing@kikagoods.com for marketing and branding partnerships. GitHub research inventory and permanent sent ledger were rechecked immediately before staging and contained no KIKAGoods/kikagoods.com key.
